enterprises.name: Yurtle
enterprises.description: Yurtle is a UK employee-benefit that blends caregiver insurance cash payouts, a vetted care-provider marketplace and an AI care-ally app to reduce workplace absence, sold to employers as a per-employee subscription.
enterprises.desc_cn: Yurtle 是英国雇主员工福利，结合照护者保险现金给付、经筛选的照护机构名单与 AI 助手应用以减少误工，按每位员工订阅向雇主收费。
enterprises.recommend: 【Yurtle】聚焦产业资本/保险/居家护理，护理管理和护理保险，B2B+B2C模式，研究价值分26。

enterprises.description: Zinnia TV streams research-backed, ad-free videos designed for people with dementia and cognitive loss, calming agitation and sparking conversation; sold as a subscription to families and long-term-care facilities.

enterprises.business_model: B2B 行业媒体/数据服务

enterprises.desc_cn: Ōmcare 生产居家健康终端，按时锁定并发放药物、支持与医护双向视频并确认服药依从性，销往健康险公司、居家护理机构与家属。
enterprises.recommend: 【Ōmcare】聚焦产业资本/保健品/健康管理，正确时间正确药物，B2B模式，研究价值分26。
